Usage: rhythm sightread verify-report <report.json> [--key <pub>]

Checks the signature <report.json>.sig that --sign wrote against this machine's
report key, the keys listed in config trusted_keys and --key. Exit 0 means the
report is unchanged and signed by one of them, 1 a bad or untrusted signature
and 2 a missing file.

Flags:
  --config <file>   read trusted_keys from this config file
  --json            print the verify document as JSON (rhythm-sightread/v1, kind
                    verify)
  --key <file>      also trust this public key file (repeatable)

Examples:
  rhythm sightread verify-report review.json
  rhythm sightread verify-report review.json --key ci-report-key.pub
